name: Chocolate Loaded Fudge Cake
description: Rich chocolate fudge cake finished with a glossy chocolate drip and loaded with chocolate bars, wafer sticks and truffles. Personalised with name and a Happy Birthday topper.
details: Personalised name included. Final decoration may vary slightly as each cake is handmade.

name: Customised 2-Tier Birthday Cake
description: Two-tier celebration cake with teddy bear figures, balloons, bunting and golden pearls in soft neutral tones. Colours, name and theme can be customised.
details: Personalised name included. Share your colour theme on WhatsApp.

name: Football Theme Cake (Fresh Cream)
description: Fresh-cream football theme cake with a football topper, grass piping and player figure – perfect for young football fans. Name and age personalised.
details: Made with normal (fresh) cream. Favourite team colours on request.

name: Masha & Bear Theme Cake – 2 Tier
description: Two-tier kids' theme cake with character figures, a cottage-door design, flowers and butterflies in pastel colours. Name and age personalised.

name: Moon & Sun Buttercream Cake
description: Fully buttercream-covered cake shaped as a crescent moon and sun, with clouds and stars piped in blue, white and gold. Personalised birthday message on the board.
details: Buttercream covered. Message and number personalised.

name: Underwater Theme Cake
description: Ocean-inspired cake with clownfish, seashells, a pearl oyster, starfish and seaweed details in aqua blue. Personalised name, age and topper.
